Model source:
https://github.com/robfiras/loco-mujoco/tree/v0.3.0/loco_mujoco/environments/data/atlas

The historical XML identifies:
  Atlas_V6 modified by Guoping Zhao.
  Atlas(v5), Boston Dynamics; OSRF DRCsim; downloaded July 27, 2015.
  Author: Vikash Kumar; Copyright 2009-2016 Roboti LLC.
The original attribution header remains in models/atlas_source.xml and models/atlas.xml.
The LocoMuJoCo repository license is copied in LOCO_MUJOCO_LICENSE.txt.

This independent tutorial modifies compiler settings, floating-base representation,
ankle roll joints, motor scaling, foot collision geometry, lighting and colors.
The Python controller is newly written for this tutorial. Boston Dynamics has not
provided this controller. The supplied model represents a historical hydraulic
Atlas, not the current electric Atlas.

Full upstream source and mesh hashes are in model_provenance.json.
